verdict.rationale: Martin documents some event-driven automation: email triage auto-labels incoming mail and takes follow-up actions, Cc'ing or forwarding emails triggers scheduling and calendar additions, and background tasks such as briefings and wake-up calls run on schedules. Custom shortcuts chain multi-step actions, but they appear to be user-invoked rather than event-triggered, and nothing shows a general user-defined rule engine. Missing for 10: explicit user-authored trigger→action rules, event types beyond email and time schedules, documentation of rule configuration and conditions, and hands-on corroboration.
